clinics.name: Donghoon Advanced Lengthening Reconstruction Institute, DALRI (Dr. Donghoon Lee)
specialties: Cosmetic stature lengthening (PRECICE, LON, LATN, external fixation)
clinics.namedDoctors: Donghoon Lee, representative doctor and director, orthopedic surgeon (per LinkedIn). The site lists no medical school, board certification or society membership for him; the Medical Staff page shows photos only. The site says anesthesia is given by 'a professional anesthesiologist from Severance Hospital' who is not named.
clinics.credentials: On the Medical Korea registered list (checked October 30, 2026) as 'Donghoon Advanced Lengthening Reconstruction Institute'. On the Medical Korea KAHF accredited page (checked October 30, 2026) showing KAHF. Site says established 2009 and occupies floors 3 to 5 of an office tower (Superstar Tower). Stated safety set-up: external anesthesiologist, nurses with over five years' experience, EOS low-dose 3D imaging, blood test, EKG, chest X-ray and urine test pre-op, UPS backup power, operating room described to US Federal Standard 209D, CPR team described as part of a 'university hospital coordinated system'. No ICU is described. Self-reported zero rates of deep infection and nonunion are unverified.
clinics.cautions: Structural: this is a clinic-level facility in an office building rather than a general hospital, and the site does not describe ICU access or a named transfer hospital. Cosmetic limb lengthening is an elective procedure with serious documented complications; in September 2025 Euronews reported UK doctors and the NHS warning against having it abroad [dalri-press-euronews]. The warning is general and does not name DALRI. No regulator action or court case naming DALRI was found.
clinics.publishedPrices: Published on its site (seen October 30, 2026, no effective date shown; KRW 1,330 = $1): femur lengthening with PRECICE KRW 117,420,000 (about $88,300); tibia lengthening with PRECICE KRW 131,760,000 (about $99,100); tibia lengthening with LON KRW 52,800,000 (about $39,700); second surgery to remove the external fixator KRW 5,940,000 (about $4,500). Listed inclusions: surgery and anesthesia fees, medications, two implants, 3 to 7 nights in a 4-bed room, three cryotherapy and one rehab session. Excluded: initial consultation and pre-op assessment, room upgrade, extra procedures or rehab, accommodation, prescriptions and supplies such as walkers and crutches.

Not on the Medical Korea 26-entry KAHF accredited page (checked October 30, 2026). No accreditations claimed on site; year founded not stated.
clinics.cautions: Structural: five-branch chain; the site shows no physician names so you cannot confirm who will treat you before arrival. Online reviews are mixed, including a few hostile forum posts about pricing for foreigners, which are unverified consumer opinions. No regulator action, court case or press-reported incident found.
clinics.publishedPrices: Not published on its site (checked October 30, 2026); a Korean non-covered fee notice is linked but was not readable.

booking.channels: Seocho branch +82-2-588-2304; Jamsil +82-2-413-2303; Bundang +82-31-711-6711; Hongje +82-2-394-8275; Dongdaemun +82-2-2275-5085; KakaoTalk channel and online forms (medical, cost, photo and appointment consultations) on the site. Hours Monday and Friday 10:00 to 20:00, Tuesday to Thursday 10:00 to 19:00, Saturday 9:30 to 16:00, lunch 13:00 to 14:00 weekdays, closed Sunday and holidays (Korea time). Email, WhatsApp and LINE not listed.
booking.consult: Photo or online consultation, then in-person consultation before any treatment is prescribed. Fees, deposit and response time are not published.
booking.languages: Site offers English, Chinese and Japanese menus; third-party listings say English-speaking doctors and English and Chinese interpreters are available, which was not confirmed on the site.

clinics.name: Yonsei University Dental Hospital (Yonsei University Health System)
specialties: University dental hospital, all dental specialties
clinics.namedDoctors: Dental clinicians are not named on the English international pages; a Find a Doctor directory exists. The 'IHC medical staff' page on the dental domain reproduces the Severance Hospital International Health Care Center physician list (John A. Linton, M.D. and colleagues, family medicine and internal medicine), not dentists.
clinics.credentials: On the Medical Korea registered list (checked October 30, 2026) as 'Yonsei University Dental Hospital' (+82-2-2228-8633). Not on the Medical Korea 26-entry KAHF accredited page (checked October 30, 2026). Founded 1915 as a dental clinic at Severance Hospital (site). No accreditations stated on the pages read. Note that the international-patient pages on the dental domain describe Severance Hospital's International Health Care Center and its contacts rather than a dental-specific desk.
clinics.cautions: Structural: the dental hospital's English international pages are shared Severance templates, so phone numbers and staff listed there belong to the main hospital's International Health Care Center; use the dental hospital's own number from Medical Korea to reach dental scheduling. No regulator action, court case or press-reported incident found.
clinics.publishedPrices: Not published on its site (checked October 30, 2026). The billing page says an estimated treatment cost is available on request before consent.

booking.channels: Dental hospital number per Medical Korea +82-2-2228-8633 (KAHF-section listing shows +82-2-2228-8998); Severance International Health Care Center +82-2-2228-5800 or 5810, appointment center +82-2-2228-1009, email ihcc@yuhs.ac, fax +82-2-362-6835; online treatment appointment at dental.severance.healthcare/sev-en/appointment/status-treatment.do. Hours not listed.
booking.consult: Bring medical records and any MRI or CT images; for direct billing, confirm coverage with your insurer first. Consultation fee, deposit terms and response time are not published.
booking.languages: Interpretation listed for Russian, Chinese, Japanese, Arabic and Mongolian, with English-speaking specialists; fast-track service for foreign patients.
booking.includes: Direct billing listed for 18 partners including Aetna, Cigna, Tricare and International SOS, subject to contract.
